summary: Host-agent review of the synthetic fixture: corrected the reported value and evaluation split, removed unsupported comparison/generalization claims, and marked the robustness ablation as not run. Method detail and source support still require author/source review. No experiment was reproduced and no source support was independently validated.

suggestions.issue: The abstract reports 98% test accuracy and superiority to all baselines, but the supplied record is 93% on validation and includes only one baseline.
suggestions.recommendation: Use the recorded value and validation split; remove the unsupported universal comparison and significance wording.

suggestions.issue: The experimental result conflicts with the supplied method record.
suggestions.recommendation: Report 93% on the DemoSet validation split and identify it as a supplied synthetic record.

suggestions.issue: The manuscript presents a robustness result although the corresponding record is not_run.
suggestions.recommendation: State that robustness is planned and has no measured outcome.

suggestions.issue: Validation records from a single seed cannot establish generalization to all datasets.
suggestions.recommendation: Limit conclusions to the recorded split and acknowledge missing robustness, test and uncertainty evidence.

suggestions.issue: The citation key is absent and the assertion that prior work resolves all failures is unsupported.
suggestions.recommendation: Remove the unsupported assertion and cite only the supplied bibliography entry with an explicit support limitation.

suggestions.issue: The method description omits the calibration fit procedure, data separation and model settings.
suggestions.recommendation: Supply the actual optimization procedure and data partition; do not invent method details to fill the gap.

suggestions.issue: The bibliography resolves the key but provides no source excerpt to establish support for the method attribution.
suggestions.recommendation: Read and supply the relevant source section before asserting citation support.

edits.original: We propose a calibrated classifier that achieves 98% accuracy on the DemoSet test split and significantly outperforms all baselines.
edits.replacement: We study a temperature-scaled classifier. In the supplied synthetic records, it achieves 93% accuracy on the DemoSet validation split; the baseline achieves 90% on the same split. Robustness and test-split performance have not been evaluated.
edits.rationale: Align the abstract with the reported metric, split and limited comparison scope.

edits.original: The proposed method achieves 98% accuracy on the DemoSet test split.
edits.replacement: The supplied synthetic record reports 93% accuracy for the proposed method on the DemoSet validation split.
edits.rationale: Correct a conflicting number and evaluation split.

edits.original: The robustness ablation confirms consistent gains.
edits.replacement: The robustness ablation is planned but has not been run; no measured robustness outcome is available.
edits.rationale: Preserve the not_run status instead of presenting a proposed experiment as completed.

edits.original: We evaluate on all datasets and prove generalization.
edits.replacement: The supplied records cover the DemoSet validation split with a single seed. They do not establish robustness, test-split performance, statistical significance or generalization to other datasets.
edits.rationale: Restrict conclusions to the supplied evidence and state unresolved evaluation limits.

edits.original: Prior work resolves all calibration failures [@missing2026].
edits.replacement: The supplied bibliography includes a calibration reference [@guo2017]; its support for the specific method claim requires inspection of the source text.
edits.rationale: Remove an unresolved reference and an unsupported universal assertion without pretending source support was verified.

claim_reviews.claim: achieves 98% accuracy on the DemoSet test split
claim_reviews.reason: The supplied record reports 93% and labels the split validation, not test.
Only one baseline and one seed are supplied; significance and all-baseline scope are not established.
The citation key matches the supplied bibliography, but the excerpt needed to assess support is absent.

claim_reviews.claim: On the DemoSet validation split, the baseline achieves 90% accuracy.
claim_reviews.reason: This matches the baseline record in dataset, split, metric and value; the record is a synthetic fixture and is not a reproduced experiment.

claim_reviews.claim: The proposed method achieves 98% accuracy on the DemoSet test split.
claim_reviews.reason: The value and split conflict with the supplied record.

claim_reviews.claim: The robustness ablation confirms consistent gains.
claim_reviews.reason: The corresponding experiment has no measurement and status not_run.

claim_reviews.claim: We evaluate on all datasets and prove generalization.
claim_reviews.reason: The record set covers validation on a single synthetic dataset and does not establish generalization.

claim_reviews.claim: Prior work resolves all calibration failures [@missing2026].
claim_reviews.reason: The cited key is absent, and no source excerpt supports the universal assertion.
